name: The Sound of the Rain
source:
A strange game came out of nothing, and two teenagers start exploring its contents, trying to get to its secrets. Who made it? And what is the meaning behind the game?

[From [url=https://fullmontis.itch.io/the-sound-of-the-rain] itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一款奇怪的游戏凭空出现，两个青少年开始探索游戏的内容，试图找出其中的秘密。谁做的？而游戏背后的意义又是什么？

[来自[url=https://fullmontis.itch.io/the-sound-of-the-rain] itch.io[/url]]
